paper.title: Analysis of Thompson Sampling for the multi-armed bandit problem

settings.definition_quote: We are given a slot machine with $N$ arms; at each time step $t=1, 2, 3, \ldots $, one of the $N$ arms must be chosen to be played. Each arm $i$, when played, yields a random real-valued reward according to some fixed (unknown) distribution with support in $[0,1]$.
For the two-armed stochastic bandit problem ($N=2$), ...

algorithms.name: Thompson Sampling for general stochastic bandits (Bernoulli-trial reduction)

extra_assumptions: unique optimal arm (argued wlog in Appendix A)

source.label: th:two-arms
source.quote: For the two-armed stochastic bandit problem ($N=2$), Thompson Sampling algorithm has expected regret $$\Ex[{\cal R}(T)] = O\left(\frac{\ln T}{\Delta}+\frac{1}{\Delta^3}\right)$$ in time $T$, where $\Delta = \mu_1-\mu_2$.

results.notes: Delta = mu_1 - mu_2 is the only gap, mapped to Delta_min. Regret defined via expected pull counts (pseudo-regret). TS does not use T; T only enters analysis.

extra_assumptions: unique optimal arm (argued wlog in Appendix A)

source.label: th:two-arms
source.quote: This gives a regret bound of $$\Ex[{\cal R}(T)] =\ExR{ \Delta \cdot \ k_2(T)} \le \left(\frac{40\ln T}{\Delta} + \frac{48}{\Delta^3} + 18\Delta\right). $$

results.notes: Explicit-constant version derived in the proof of Theorem 1, not stated as a separate formal statement.

extra_assumptions: unique optimal arm (argued wlog in Appendix A)

source.label: th:N-arms
source.quote: For the $N$-armed stochastic bandit problem, Thompson Sampling algorithm has expected regret $$\Ex[{\cal R}(T)] \leq O\left(\left(\sum_{a=2}^N\frac{1}{\Delta_a^2}\right)^2 \ln T\right)$$ in time $T$, where $\Delta_i=\mu_1-\mu_i$.

results.notes: Paper's N is the number of arms K. Appendix gives explicit constants (leading 1152 ln T (sum 1/Delta^2)^2 plus lower-order terms).

extra_assumptions: unique optimal arm (argued wlog in Appendix A)

source.label: rem:N-arms
source.quote: For the $N$-armed bandit problem, we can obtain an alternate bound of $$\Ex[{\cal R}(T)] \leq O\left(\frac{\Delta_{max}}{\Delta_{min}^3}\left(\sum_{a=2}^N\frac{1}{\Delta_a^2}\right) \ln T\right)$$ by slight modification to the proof.

results.notes: Stated as a remark with proof sketched in appendix.

cited_results.cited_title: Finite-time analysis of the multiarmed bandit problem
